## Security and privacy review

- [ ] No tokens, private keys, production URLs, customer payloads, proprietary source, or real
      error data are included.
- [ ] Redaction, outbound data, and failure behavior were reviewed.
- [ ] New dependencies are justified and security-reviewed, or no dependencies were added.

## Performance and compatibility review

- [ ] Synchronous work, memory, queue, and notifier impact considered.
- [ ] Node.js, Express/NestJS, ESM/CommonJS, and TypeScript compatibility impact considered.
